canonical_identity.title: Hindi to Mundari Translation Dataset Corpus

provenance.provider_statement: The public repository states that the corpus contains Hindi sentences translated into Mundari and stores the pairs in a two-column TSV.
provenance.count_semantics: 17826 is a provider-reported corpus quantity and is not an MLHKP audited-source, claim, or evidence count.

rights.provider_summary: Provider states noncommercial distribution/remix/adaptation is allowed with attribution and share-alike conditions, including software-related conditions.
rights.mlhkp_interpretation: License text must be retained and applied to any redistributed/adapted material. Dataset copyright/reuse permission does not establish participant consent, cultural permission, or permission for unrelated source material from which Hindi prompts may derive.

deterministic_canonicalization.dedup_rule: Repository metadata, licence/copyright files and TSV are manifestations/components of one corpus identity, not independent corroborating sources.
deterministic_canonicalization.dependency_rule: Any overlap with MunTTS, Adivaani, AdiBhasha, shared-task or other translation corpora must be resolved by deterministic row/hash comparison before independent-evidence status is assigned.

promotion.reason: This run verifies source identity, provider-reported structure and licence surface only. Row-level ingestion requires immutable permitted bytes/hash, deterministic row enumeration and overlap analysis, prompt/source provenance, and participant/privacy/cultural-access review.

required_before_promotion: verify physical row count against provider-reported 17826
trace Hindi prompt/source dependencies where discoverable
link only supported permitted rows to evidence graph

release_note: Do not inflate controlled MMSC counts until this locator is reconciled against the WEB-MUN ledger.
